data_needed: Binance perpetual futures trade-by-trade tick data (six contracts)
signed order flow / order imbalance at second resolution
trade size roundness from individual prints
method: Clock-phase (quarter-hour) conditioning of intraday returns and order imbalance, displayed via an Autocorrelation Map, with out-of-sample prediction of opening returns and 4-12h returns from opening imbalance.
reason: Entirely built on Binance trade-level microstructure (tick prints, trade size roundness, signed imbalance); Coinbase OHLCV bars cannot recover order flow or roundness.

data_needed: daily adjusted closes for 20 named S&P 500 constituents (TMUS, PPG, LYB, ALB, GPC, STE, WRB, VRTX, BLK, VEEV, INCY, PAYX, TXT, CSCO, MOS, OXY, HON, MAS, AMGN, IEX), Jan 2018 - Jun 2026, Yahoo Finance
reproducible_targets: Table 2: LPAS-W out-of-sample annualized return 26.28%, Sharpe ratio 1.30, final wealth 1.61 over the 515-observation test window
Table 2 baseline rows: equal-weight, predict-then-optimize, and historical Wasserstein DRO metrics on the same 20-asset panel
Figures 1-2: cumulative wealth and drawdown paths of LPAS vs baselines over the 2018-2026 test period
method: A deep contextual network emits a nominal scenario distribution plus a state-dependent Wasserstein radius, defining a contextual ambiguity set for a distributionally robust portfolio choice trained with decision loss.
reason: Universe, tickers, sample split and frequency are fully disclosed and the only input is daily equity returns available free from Yahoo Finance; exact parity depends on retraining a neural net, hence the moderate confidence.

data_needed: none - synthetic continuous-double-auction simulation only
method: Agent-based limit order book with fundamental-anchored zero-intelligence liquidity plus a mid-anchored chartist herding layer, mapped over a phi-kappa phase diagram (7x6 grid, 336 runs) to locate a liquidity-stress crossover.
reason: Pure order-book simulation with no market data, so there is nothing to check parity against using free datasets; results are properties of the authors' simulator, not of observable prices.

data_needed: Uniswap v3 on-chain event logs (Mint/Burn/Swap) per pool and tick
Ethereum block-level protocol-fee switch timestamps
pool-level active liquidity and local depth reconstruction
method: Matched-overlap event-study difference-in-differences around the tier-differentiated Uniswap protocol-fee switch, estimating the LP-side take-rate elasticity of active liquidity and local depth.
reason: Requires reconstructing a pool-tick liquidity panel from Ethereum on-chain logs; no equity, macro, or Coinbase OHLCV source in the stack can produce it.

data_needed: S&P 500 index option prices across strikes and maturities (OptionMetrics-style surface)
risk-free / forward curve for option discounting
method: Recovers a volatility-scaled stochastic discount factor from the cross-section of SPX option prices and uses it to forecast the equity premium against the Martin lower bound.
reason: The entire object is estimated from option chains, which are outside the free data stack; the equity-premium forecast cannot be rebuilt without the surface.

data_needed: Kalshi contract-level hourly prices, volume and bid-ask spreads, Aug 2021 - Apr 2026
contract metadata (category, resolution deadline)
method: Structural volatility model for binary contracts combining a Wright-Fisher deadline-resolution term with a Glosten-Milgrom adverse-selection term driven by spread and volume, optionally layered with residual GARCH.
reason: Needs an hourly Kalshi prediction-market panel with spreads and volume (~880k contract-hours); no prediction-market feed exists in the Vintage sources.

data_needed: daily prices for an undisclosed 30-name global innovation book (US, Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japan, Europe)
the portfolio's USD position weights
method: PCA of a book's own return covariance, ranking components by risk contribution rather than variance, plus density clustering, a sign-invariant PCA Risk Score, a Bleed score and a trailing-return timing gate, with LLM-generated factor labels.
reason: The paper explicitly withholds the 30 holdings and their weights, so the headline figures (+47.3% total return, 17.9% vol, Sharpe 2.04, -16.2% max drawdown, PC3 risk contribution 21.1%) cannot be matched even though the price data itself would be free.

data_needed: daily adjusted closes for S&P 500 constituents, Jan 2005 - Dec 2022 (Yahoo Finance), filtered to the 417 names with under 5% missing data
optionally Ken French factor returns to regress the detected statistical factors on FF economic factors
reproducible_targets: Figure 7: IGF-detected factor count fluctuating roughly between 4 and 14 across the 185 moving windows while the Onatski test returns 1 factor in most windows
Median detected factor count of 7 at threshold tau = 0.3 over the 185 windows of 834 daily observations shifted by 20 trading days
Figure 8: sensitivity of the detected factor count to the participation-ratio threshold tau
method: Iterative global-factor (IGF) detection using the participation-ratio structure of Brown-Harding factor eigenvectors to separate weak factors from Marcenko-Pastur edge noise near the BBP transition.
reason: Empirical panel is just daily S&P 500 log returns 2005-2022 with a stated missing-data filter and window scheme, all obtainable from Yahoo Finance; the only wrinkle is index-membership survivorship in the 417-name screen.

data_needed: none - synthetic diffusion economies only
method: Continuous-time portfolio choice where assets are conditionally independent given a low-dimensional driver set, decomposing the optimal policy into a myopic allocation plus an intertemporal hedge against rotation and jumps of the conditioning manifold.
reason: Theory paper whose 13 figures and 4 tables come from controlled synthetic diffusions, so there is no empirical result to reproduce against free data.

data_needed: Open Source Asset Pricing (openassetpricing.com) long-short portfolio returns and predictor definitions for ~200 published anomalies
market capitalization breakpoints for the non-micro / top-3,000 screens
Ken French market factor for the CAPM alpha regressions
reproducible_targets: Median zero-investment long-short return of 48 bp/month through Dec 2005 (all stocks) falling to 19 bp post-2005, 26 bp for non-micro, and 7 bp for post-2005 non-micro
Post-2005 non-micro panel: median t-statistic 0.45, median CAPM alpha 9 bp/month with t-stat 0.64, median annualized Sharpe 0.11, interquartile range -4 to +18 bp, 67% of anomalies positive
Empirical Bayes shrinkage step: cross-anomaly variance of t-statistics of 1.09 implying a near-zero luck-adjusted return even for top-decile anomalies
method: Recomputes ~200 published long-short anomaly portfolios from the Chen-Zimmermann open-source signal library under alternative sample periods and size screens, then shrinks the cross-section of t-statistics for luck.
reason: Built directly on the free openassetpricing.com dataset, which is a first-class Vintage source, and every headline statistic is a simple median over portfolio return series.
